Remove what attach wrote and nothing else: the recorded files, their empty directories, the exclude block and the record (alias: jack-out) (construct detach v<version>)

USAGE construct detach [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

  --dir=<dir>    Target directory (Default: .)                    
      --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)
     --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)
